rationale: Composed partial-round linear map: precomputed 8×30 coefficient matrix replaces depth-22 symbolic expressions. Added 240 be muls per AIR eval for the composed final state recomputation, on top of the existing 330 be muls in the iterative loop. Net +1.45% regression (p≈0). The extra muls outweigh any instruction-scheduling benefit from flatter expressions.
diagnostic: The iterative S-box loop cannot be eliminated because state[0] at each round depends on state[1..7] from the previous round via sparse_first_row dot product. The composed map is ADDITIVE, not a replacement. The hypothesis assumed the composed map would eliminate expression-tree overhead in the constraint folder, but the constraint folder operates on concrete packed values (not symbolic trees), so expression depth is irrelevant for the prover hot path.

rationale: 3-level SplitEq factorization: eq_hi reduced from ~34 KiB to ~3 KiB, trivially L1-resident. Manual 3-round counterbalanced measurement: base_avg=4.835s, cand_avg=4.828s, delta=-0.15% (noise). The eq tables are NOT the dominant TLB pressure source — the multilinear column data (hundreds of MB) dwarfs the eq tables and dominates the 48% dTLB miss rate.
diagnostic: Kill condition triggered: dTLB miss rate reduction < 10pp. The eq_hi table at ~34 KiB was already borderline L1 and accessed sequentially (good prefetch). The real TLB pressure comes from random-access patterns over multilinear column arrays during fold-and-compute, which the 3-level SplitEq does not address.

rationale: Vectorized product sumcheck first-round base×ext accumulation: replaced per-lane scalar extraction with fully packed PF operations. The product sumcheck is only ~4.5% of total proving time, so even a 15% speedup of that component gives <1% wall-clock improvement.

The original scalar lane iteration was likely auto-vectorized by LLVM, so the explicit packed version provides only marginal instruction-level improvement. The fundamental bottleneck remains the locked Poseidon permutation (34.5%) which cannot be optimized.

diagnostic: The ZERO-initializer pattern changes the symbolic expression tree shape, enabling dot_product_be in the recursion compiler. But for the CONCRETE evaluator (ConstraintFolder), it adds a measurably redundant ZERO+add at the start of each MDS accumulation. LLVM cannot optimize this away because the value is algebraically type-opaque (packed AVX512 with modular reduction semantics).
